summary: Iteration 43 - Partial Payments Feature Testing Complete. All backend APIs verified: POST /api/factures/{id}/pay (record partial/full payment), GET /api/factures/{id}/payments (payment history), status transitions (emise -> partiel -> payee). Frontend Admin verified: 'Paiement partiel' badge in orange/amber, 'Payé' and 'Reste dû' amounts in facture detail. Frontend Client Portal verified: 'Reste dû' column in factures table, 'Payer X€' button shows remaining amount. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified.

issues: Cookie consent banner persists and blocks UI elements - may need to be dismissed more aggressively or have higher z-index handling
